```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext-img SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment exercising parser comment state -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with <tags> & &ent; references inside.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base-ent "Database Record">
  <!ENTITY complex-ent "&base-ent; Extended">
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="backup" action="init"?>
<database xmlns="http://xml.example.com/db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment detailing record structure -->
  <record xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like syntax inside CDATA --!>
    ]]>
    &complex-ent;
  </record>
</database>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %ext-macro;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY internal-ref "Internal Reference Text">
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:custom="http://doc.org/custom">
  <!-- Comment before section elements -->
  <section id="s1">
    <custom:sub>
      <![CDATA[
        Raw CDATA containing &internal-ref; and unparsed entities.
      ]]>
    </custom:sub>
    &internal-ref;
  </section>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "&ent-a; Beta">
  <!ENTITY ent-c "&ent-b; Gamma">
]>
<?xml-target directive="load-config"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:m="http://catalog.org/ns/metadata">
  <!-- Comment preceding metadata and cdata -->
  <m:metadata>
    <![CDATA[
      <m:metadata-content>
        Entity chain: &ent-c;
      </m:metadata-content>
    ]]>
  </m:metadata>
  <item>&ent-c;</item>
</catalog>
```

    &stock-ent;
  </inv:stock>
</inventory>
